description: Test whether somatic ATM mutation rate is explained by tumour mutational burden, and compare germline vs somatic truncating fractions
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, json
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
API="https://www.cbioportal.org/api"

studies=[s for s in requests.get(f"{API}/studies",timeout=60).json() if s["studyId"].endswith("_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018")]
rows=[]
for s in studies:
    sid=s["studyId"]; prof=f"{sid}_mutations"; slist=f"{sid}_all"
    sl=requests.get(f"{API}/sample-lists/{slist}",timeout=60).json(); n=len(sl.get("sampleIds",[]))
    muts=requests.post(f"{API}/molecular-profiles/{prof}/mutations/fetch",params={"projection":"DETAILED"},
                       json={"entrezGeneIds":[472],"sampleListId":slist},timeout=120).json()
    samp={m["sampleId"] for m in muts}
    TR=("Nonsense_Mutation","Frame_Shift_Del","Frame_Shift_Ins","Splice_Site","Nonstop_Mutation","Translation_Start_Site")
    trunc={m["sampleId"] for m in muts if m.get("mutationType") in TR}
    # tumour mutational burden proxy
    cd=requests.get(f"{API}/studies/{sid}/clinical-data",
                    params={"attributeId":"MUTATION_COUNT","clinicalDataType":"SAMPLE","pageSize":10000},timeout=120).json()
    mc=[float(x["value"]) for x in cd if x.get("value") not in (None,"","NA")]
    rows.append({"cancer":s["name"].replace(" (TCGA, PanCancer Atlas)",""),
                 "code":sid.replace("_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018","").upper(),
                 "n":n,"atm_mut":len(samp),"atm_trunc":len(trunc),
                 "pct_atm":100*len(samp)/n if n else np.nan,
                 "median_tmb":float(np.median(mc)) if mc else np.nan})
df=pd.DataFrame(rows).dropna(subset=["pct_atm","median_tmb"])
df["frac_trunc"]=np.where(df.atm_mut>0, df.atm_trunc/df.atm_mut, np.nan)

rho,p = stats.spearmanr(df["median_tmb"], df["pct_atm"])
print("Spearman: somatic ATM mutation rate vs median tumour mutation count across %d TCGA types" % len(df))
print("  rho = %.3f, p = %.2e" % (rho,p))
r2,p2 = stats.pearsonr(np.log10(df["median_tmb"]), df["pct_atm"])
print("  Pearson(log10 TMB, %%ATM) r = %.3f, p = %.2e, R2 = %.2f" % (r2,p2,r2**2))

germline_sites = {"BRCA","PAAD","PRAD","OV"}
print("\nGermline ATM-associated sites vs others:")
g = df[df.code.isin(germline_sites)]; o = df[~df.code.isin(germline_sites)]
print("  germline-associated sites median %%ATM somatic = %.2f%% (n=%d types)" % (g.pct_atm.median(), len(g)))
print("  all other sites median %%ATM somatic = %.2f%% (n=%d types)" % (o.pct_atm.median(), len(o)))
u,pu = stats.mannwhitneyu(g.pct_atm, o.pct_atm, alternative="two-sided")
print("  Mann-Whitney U = %.1f, p = %.3f" % (u,pu))

print("\nGermline vs somatic truncating fraction:")
print("  germline ClinVar P/LP truncating = 95.6%% (3616/3781)")
print("  somatic TCGA truncating = %.1f%% (%d/%d)" % (100*df.atm_trunc.sum()/df.atm_mut.sum(), df.atm_trunc.sum(), df.atm_mut.sum()))
chi = stats.chi2_contingency([[3616, 3781-3616],[int(df.atm_trunc.sum()), int(df.atm_mut.sum()-df.atm_trunc.sum())]])
print("  chi2 = %.1f, p = %.3g" % (chi[0], chi[1]))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,5.5))
ax[0].scatter(df["median_tmb"], df["pct_atm"], s=55, c="#4C78A8", edgecolor="k", linewidth=.4)
for _,r in df.iterrows():
    if r.pct_atm>3 or r.median_tmb>80: ax[0].annotate(r["code"],(r["median_tmb"],r["pct_atm"]),fontsize=8,
                                                      xytext=(4,3),textcoords="offset points")
ax[0].set_xscale("log"); ax[0].set_xlabel("Median somatic mutation count per tumour (log scale)")
ax[0].set_ylabel("Tumours with a somatic ATM mutation (%)")
ax[0].set_title("Somatic ATM mutation rate tracks tumour mutational burden\nSpearman rho = %.2f, p = %.1e (%d TCGA types)"%(rho,p,len(df)),fontsize=11)

lab=["Germline\n(ClinVar P/LP)","Somatic\n(TCGA PanCan)"]
val=[100*3616/3781, 100*df.atm_trunc.sum()/df.atm_mut.sum()]
b=ax[1].bar(lab,val,color=["#C44E52","#4C78A8"],width=.55)
for bb,v in zip(b,val): ax[1].text(bb.get_x()+bb.get_width()/2, v+1.5, f"{v:.1f}%", ha="center", fontsize=12)
ax[1].set_ylim(0,110); ax[1].set_ylabel("Truncating share of ATM mutations (%)")
ax[1].set_title("Germline ATM lesions are truncating, somatic ones mostly are not\nchi2 = %.0f, p = %.1e"%(chi[0],chi[1]),fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
